summary: Ships a static site through a caching CDN proxy the pipeline cannot purge by making the emitted URL the invalidation lever — content-hashed assets, versioned service-worker registration, exact-match caching, network-first navigations, allow-list rsync — and produces an edge-freshness report that records what the edge served rather than what CI built.

assumes_loaded.why: Cache-key design and origin shielding sit upstream of this; that decides the headers this one has to live with.
The stamping step belongs to a build that renders everything before writing anything; a half-written site defeats the hash.
